plan.restatement: The XRP reserve an agent wallet needs and how much each open escrow or trust line adds.
subqueries: XRPL owner reserve per object escrow trust line
XRPL reserve requirement escrow trust line increase

lead: An XRPL wallet needs a base reserve plus applicable owner reserves, separately from the money it intends to send.
results.conclusion: An XRPL wallet needs a base reserve plus applicable owner reserves, separately from the money it intends to send. The reserve documentation lists Mainnet settings of 1 XRP per account and 0.2 XRP per owned item at access time, and warns that other networks can differ. Base reserve supports the account's existence; owner reserve constrains ledger objects. Removing an object can release its reserve requirement. Reserves are not payments to validators, and the documentation permits reserved XRP to pay transaction costs. Treating every XRP in a balance as transferable would therefore confuse sever
